description: Current prices for one product at a single retailer, given as a domain such as amazon.com, bestbuy.com or target.com: each offer from that store (including marketplace sellers) with price, availability, condition, when it was last checked and a link, followed by a ShopSavvy source line. Prices are in US dollars. Use product_offers to compare every retailer at once. Free without an API key; 2 credits with a key, nothing when no offers are found. If that retailer has no offer, say so; do not substitute another store's price.

identifier.description: Product identifier (barcode, ASIN, URL, model number, product name, or ShopSavvy ID)

title: Current prices at one retailer
